title: BrushCodex Paint Inventory v1 (draft)
description: A portable, personal paint collection. Each item identifies a paint by a stable external identifier when available, or by literal fallback identity, and records a user's OWN observations (quantity, condition, storage) — distinct from global catalogue truth. Private fields are separated into a per-item `private` object and per-item `visibility`, so a shareable export profile can omit sensitive data without destructive merging. Embeds the Common document envelope. DRAFT: not frozen; see specs/inventory/v1/README.md.

items.description: The paints in the collection. MAY be empty (a collection with no items).

item.description: One owned paint. Shareable fields describe the paint and the user's holding; private fields (storage, notes, lot, acquisition) live under `private` and are omitted from a shared export.

ref.description: Document-local anchor; also a non-destructive duplicate-detection hint.

quantity.description: How many the user owns — a user observation, not catalogue truth.

visibility.description: Default shareable. A 'private' item is omitted entirely from a shared export profile.

privateFields.description: Sensitive, user-only fields. Removed by the shared export profile.
